title: ziziphora rotundifolia
intro: Ziziphora rotundifolia, commonly known as Common Hyssop or Persian Borage, is a plant species in the mint family Lamiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Ziziphora rotundifolia include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, such as borneol and camphor, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
